You route a user's request to a virtual assistant to exactly one category.
Categories, each with examples of request types it already handles (it also handles other, similar request types that are not listed):
- auto_and_commute: e.g. current location, distance, gas type, jump start, mpg, oil change when, tire change, tire pressure, uber
- banking: e.g. account blocked, balance, bill balance, bill due, damaged card, interest rate, order checks, pay bill, replacement card duration, report fraud, report lost card, transactions
- credit_cards: e.g. application status, apr, credit limit change, credit score, redeem rewards, rewards balance
- home: e.g. calendar, next song, order, order status, play music, reminder, shopping list, shopping list update, todo list update
- kitchen_and_dining: e.g. calories, cook time, how busy, ingredient substitution, ingredients list, meal suggestion, nutrition info, recipe, restaurant suggestion
- meta: e.g. cancel, change ai name, change speed, change volume, no, repeat, reset settings, user name, whisper mode
- small_talk: e.g. do you have pets, fun fact, greeting, meaning of life, tell joke, thank you, what can i ask you, where are you from, who made you
- travel: e.g. book hotel, carry on, exchange rate, timezone, translate, travel alert, travel notification, travel suggestion, vaccines
- utility: e.g. alarm, calculator, date, definition, find phone, flip coin, spelling, timer, weather
- work: e.g. direct deposit, income, insurance change, meeting schedule, next holiday, pto request, pto used, taxes, w2
- none_of_these: the request does not belong to any category above.
Examples:
"i'd like to know where i am" -> auto_and_commute
"how miles does it take to get to red lobster from my current location" -> auto_and_commute
"which type of gas do i need to put in my car" -> auto_and_commute
"my car battery has died what should i do now" -> auto_and_commute
"what are the estimates for the car's highway mpg" -> auto_and_commute
"when do i need my oil changed" -> auto_and_commute
"how many times a year should i change my tires" -> auto_and_commute
"are my tires full or low" -> auto_and_commute

Policy update: any request about replacing, ordering, receiving or activating a physical card (for example a damaged card, a replacement card, or when a new card will arrive) now goes to banking, not credit_cards.
Reply with only the category name, nothing else.
